<!-- closer-core/v1 followup-of=stranske/Orchestrator#428@511 -->
## Why
The remaining work spans real dispute inventory, semantic execution, durable reporting and observed closer integration; it exceeds a focused repair of the productive packet-validation patch.
Source issue #428; merged PR #511 delivered: PR #511 strengthens build_packet member validation and adds regression coverage for malformed evidence, stale or untrusted verifier decisions, and read-only switch-review rendering. It also preserves and clarifies evidence receipts, but does not establish completion of the 71-dispute retrospective or operational live-shadow acceptance.

## Scope
- Inspect current main and existing receipts first; retain the merged validation and regression work.
- Establish a read-only inventory of the requested 71 disputes, explicitly recording exclusions, unavailable evidence and any inventory discrepancy.
- Guard empty commits.nodes in both initial and paginated gate reads, record a per-case evidence gap, and continue the batch; add regressions for both paths.
- Run the retrospective with outcome writes prohibited; persist per-case role runs, evidence gaps, comparisons and measured costs or explicit UNKNOWN values.
- Demonstrate live-shadow invocation at a real contested closer disposition and no offer for an uncontested verdict, with authoritative outcomes unchanged.
- Retrieve and validate the required named-test mutation receipts, or reproduce them in isolation; inspect the failed merge-commit verify.py log and resolve or substantiate its relevance.
- Reconcile the saved report and switch-review output with the actual run, and correct completion metadata so bounded work cannot imply broad acceptance.

## Non-Goals
- Do not redo work that PR #511 already delivered.

## Tasks
- [ ] Inspect current main and existing receipts first; retain the merged validation and regression work.
- [ ] Establish a read-only inventory of the requested 71 disputes, explicitly recording exclusions, unavailable evidence and any inventory discrepancy.
- [ ] Guard empty commits.nodes in both initial and paginated gate reads, record a per-case evidence gap, and continue the batch; add regressions for both paths.
- [ ] Run the retrospective with outcome writes prohibited; persist per-case role runs, evidence gaps, comparisons and measured costs or explicit UNKNOWN values.
- [ ] Demonstrate live-shadow invocation at a real contested closer disposition and no offer for an uncontested verdict, with authoritative outcomes unchanged.
- [ ] Retrieve and validate the required named-test mutation receipts, or reproduce them in isolation; inspect the failed merge-commit verify.py log and resolve or substantiate its relevance.
- [ ] Reconcile the saved report and switch-review output with the actual run, and correct completion metadata so bounded work cannot imply broad acceptance.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every requested dispute is accounted for by a persisted shadow result or an explicit evidence gap; inventory discrepancies are reported.
- [ ] Empty initial and paginated gate responses record gaps without aborting subsequent cases.
- [ ] All three named acceptance tests pass on the evaluated source.
- [ ] Enabling an outcomes write fails the second named test; enabling uncontested offers fails the third; exact restoration passes.
- [ ] A real contested closer disposition produces a shadow record while authoritative outcomes remain unchanged.
- [ ] The saved summary and switch-review line agree with persisted case counts and measured or explicitly unknown costs.

## Implementation Notes
Verifier report (excerpt):

```
ce retrieval is incomplete: PR comments and referenced workflow artifacts were bounded/unavailable. Therefore the required deliberate-break evidence and complete confirmation of the named acceptance tests remain unverifiable, rather than demonstrably absent.; The visible source change correctly strengthens build_packet validation for blank or malformed list members, and its parameterized test covers 12 negative examples plus supported positive shapes. However, the shown change alone does not establish all Issue #428 deliverables: retrospective role-run recording, durability/fleet-shape comparison and report writing, contested-verdict closer-lane behavior, and switch-review output rely on code not fully presented in the changed-code evidence.; The added nested validation helpers in build_packet lack type annotations or docstrings and encode GitHub evidence schemas inline. This is understandable for a small patch but makes future supported-shape changes easier to miss or duplicate.; Validation accepts any nonblank string as a diff or gate reference. That matches the stated preservation of textual references, but means semantic validity of such references is intentionally deferred; callers must not treat packet construction as proof that referenced evidence is retrievable or trustworthy.
- anthropic: Coverage is incomplete: 8 changed files (the gzipped red/green transcripts, JUnit XML and node-cli capture) are omitted from the prompt, and the PR comment and artifact retrieval is partial. The deliberate-break to revert evidence cannot be fully confirmed from what was supplied. Under the coverage gate this cannot be PASS.; CI gate: ci.yml concluded failure on the merge commit, in the 'verify.py (real pytest counts + selftests + capability gates)' job. That floors the verdict at CONCERNS, and the diff does not explain the failure.; The PR body says 'Closes #428' (the pr-preamble block), but also says #428 stays open and that this is a bounded follow-up. The issue's broad deliverables (full inventory, semantic adjudication, native costs, later-truth acceptance) are explicitly not claimed. Merging could close #428 prematurely.; The docs note records an unresolved bug: an empty `commits.nodes` in a gate read raises IndexError instead of saving an evidence gap and continuing the batch. The retrospective batch path is left with a known defect.; The new `build_packet` guards are correct on their face. They reject blank, null, numeric and incomplete-mapping members, and accept CheckRun and StatusContext shapes and path-bearing diff dicts. But `gate_entry` accepts a bare nonblank string, so a gate run like 'x' passes. That is a weak check, though it matches the documented preservation of textual references.; The manifest repair is hash-based and refers to revision 47156fb. The README states the current README bytes differ from the bound revision. This is documented but needs `git show` to verify, and it does not affect runtime behavior.; The new JS CLI tests for stale head, stale merge, wrong PR, untrusted author and newer-PASS replay look sound. They are not tied to the named acceptance tests, and the added switch_review test documents that Python pytest was not rerun in that round.

### 🔍 LangSmith Traces
- [openai](https://smith.langchain.com/r/lc_run--01a11630-abf5-78f2-b4c5-6bfa2dd51fab-0)
- [anthropic](https://smith.langchain.com/r/lc_run--01a11630-d57a-79e1-b431-75255baf9b3a-0)

---

Workflow state fingerprint for Agents Verifier. Do not edit.
```
